author: elherooftime
quote: It’s an entertaining game, but honestly, it’s nothing extraordinary—contrary to what everyone else says. It has some good points, like the graphics and a great soundtrack, but that’s about it. Both the gameplay and the story are very basic—definitely not the marvel some people claim. There are many things you can no longer do; that sense of freedom to do whatever you want has largely been lost. I still think GTA V is far superior in terms of gameplay and story, and for me, Red Dead Redemption 2 remains Rockstar’s magnum opus.

author: elherooftime
quote: This game is phenomenal—artistically beautiful, with stunning graphics, and fluid, dynamic gameplay. It’s like revisiting a place from your childhood: it looks different, yet at the same time, it remains the same. I will cherish this work of art for the rest of my life.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
